summary: Iter67 duplicate + per-member amount_due batch verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (test_iter67_duplicate_and_perdue.py). Signup/Paperwork/Payment /duplicate endpoints all return a new resource with '<name> (copy)' suffix, require team_access (401/403 without auth), and clear the volatile parts (signup claims, paperwork checkmarks, payment paid/amount_paid), preserving structure. Payment duplicate correctly preserves amount, excluded_member_ids and per-member amount_due while zeroing paid/amount_paid. PER-MEMBER AMOUNT DUE: PUT /api/team/payments/{id}/member/{mid} with {amount_due:40, paid:true, amount_paid:40} fully covers that member (excluded from short_count / outstanding). PUT {amount_due:60} without paid leaves them owing 60 (verified summary.outstanding >= 60). PUT {amount_due:null} correctly falls back to tracker default 100 (outstanding jumped to include 60 gap for previously-covered member). Frontend: Duplicate icons (signup-duplicate-*, paperwork-duplicate-*, payment-duplicate-*) verified visible and functional — clicking increments list count from 1 to 2 with '(copy)' suffix rendered. Payment member sheet shows Amount due field (testID payment-member-due) with placeholder=tracker default (100), plus Amount paid, Mark paid button, and 'Save amount due only' button (testID payment-member-savedue) for unpaid members. Entering 40 and tapping Save amount due only saved the value; row then renders 'owes $40' correctly. Cleanup done: all TEST_UI67_* / TEST_iter67_* signups, paperwork, trackers, and roster members (including all ' (copy)' entries) removed. applereview team_access=True confirmed.
action_items: No fixes required — iter67 duplicate endpoints and per-member amount_due (backend + frontend) verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/team_payments.py duplicate_payment_tracker (L206-225): correctly preserves amount, excluded_member_ids, and per-member amount_due (filters entries by amount_due is not None) while clearing paid/amount_paid — this matches the spec precisely.

backend/routers/team_payments.py _summary (L46-63): per-member due logic uses e.get('amount_due') when set, else tracker.amount, so short_count and outstanding correctly reflect mixed dues. Verified with 40/40 covered + 60 unpaid + null-fallback scenarios.

backend/routers/team_payments.py set_member_status (L228-267): uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so PUT {amount_due:null} explicitly sets entry.amount_due=None (fallback to tracker default), while omitting the key leaves the existing value. Correct semantics.
backend/routers/signups.py duplicate_signup (L87-102): creates fresh SignupSlot objects (new uuids) with no claims, name suffixed ' (copy)'. Solid.
backend/routers/paperwork.py duplicate_paperwork (L92-103): creates fresh PaperworkItem objects (new uuids) and empty values map. Solid.

frontend/app/team/payment.tsx openMember (L57-67): correctly initialises mDue from entry.amount_due (blank when not set → placeholder shows tracker default). saveDueOnly (L91-102) sends {amount_due: number|null} without touching paid — matches PUT semantics.
frontend/app/team/{signups,paperwork,payments}.tsx: each list row has correct testID `{signup|paperwork|payment}-duplicate-<id>` wired to POST /duplicate then reload — clean UX with hitSlop=8.
